meaning: S5 reading of NECESSARY_2. The OPEN T and 5 schemas give a reflexive Euclidean (S5) frame by the T and 5 correspondences; by the verified S5 law (MODAL-S5-LAWS) possible collapse at w leaves no proposition contingent at w (possibly true and possibly false). The existence of the node's witness is such a proposition: true at w, which w accesses, and false at the accessible world lacking it. Without the 5 schema the rival, the node and the T schema hold together (false-le-true frame); without the node the rival holds.
